event.past_the_point.1.text: Felix explained floating to me very kindly, so I knitted a life jacket! It goes over the real one. For morale!
event.past_the_point.1.why: no longer opens 'I knitted' like elara_heart5.0; Felix's kindness lands first

event.elara_heart8.intro.text: Shut the door a minute! Remember the shy list behind the kettle? The doodles are brave now. Don't laugh. ...Laugh a little.
event.elara_heart8.intro.why: pays off heart5's 'when the doodles are braver' (heart5 flag is required, so the player saw it)

event.elara_courtship.intro.text: Made you a scarf. Mind the end, it trails. The last row took all my nerve. It's a question: would you court me? In red. Red means very serious!
event.elara_courtship.intro.why: drops 'nine tries' so r0's 'nine feet' is the scene's only nine; three scenes carried nines

event.elara_partners.intro.text: Hat delivery! It looked lonely, so it got a smaller hat. So did that one. Somebody had to stop me. Nobody did. There are three!
event.elara_partners.intro.why: varies the opener (heart5 and this both began 'I ...'); three hats stay as the escalation of the birthday bit

threads.elara_heart2: There is a map behind the kettle, of everywhere she hasn't been — yet.
threads.elara_heart5: The map has a friend now, a list; she'll show it when the doodles are braver.
threads.elara_heart8: One place is circled in pen — and Felix owns a boat; she's just saying it near you.
threads.past_the_point: One pencil stroke through forty-odd places, and Felix wants a bigger boat for the rest.
threads.elara_garden_visit: Three dandelions and three wild garlic — and Edmund's comfrey, tied with the same green twine every spring.
threads.elara_birthday: The scarf keeps every kind word in red rows — row nine hundred and counting.
threads.elara_courtship: The scarf grows a row a day, behind the kettle, next to the list, until the player answers.
threads.elara_courtship2: The scarf reaches the door now; it is warm and patient, and so is she.
threads.elara_partners: They counted boats at sunset — someday one of them is theirs.
threads.overheard_felix_elara_1: A boat-sized knit is coming; Felix's boat looked cold.
threads.overheard_felix_elara_2: The whole waiting room already knows the fish and the scarf are friends.
threads.overheard_felix_elara_3: Dawn knitting at the beach is becoming a habit; the fish never interrupt.

notes: Kept 'Eleven hours' in overheard_elara_odalys_3.l1 as directed; Dr. Penn's correction to twelve stands.
Hinge words untouched: 'surprise' (overheard_elara_odalys_2.l1) and 'friends' (overheard_felix_elara_2.l2); event.past_the_point.3's pencil stroke kept for Felix's 'one place off the list'.
past_the_point staging uses '(sfx click)' — not in the sfx vocabulary; suggest 'clink' or, if it exists, the needle-click asset (it would be very me).
elara_heart2 beat keys play .0 .1 .2 .4 .3; kept per mechanics, but worth renumbering before another pass (same issue Felix flagged in felix_heart2).
Birthday's hat-and-smaller-hat and partners' three hats are kept as one escalating bit, not a duplicate; partners never names the birthday scene since it isn't guaranteed seen.
